what: R30 v1.1 diagnostic probe protocol (v3), registered before any v3 measurement
sources: R30_v1_1_补充审查与最小实验计划_20261101_CN.md §四 §五 §六 §九

batches.update: NB=64 x 128 FIT (train) observed pairs: numpy default_rng(20261101).permutation(145000)[:8192]
batches.heldout: NB=64 x 128 FIT pairs, the NEXT 8192 indices of the same permutation (disjoint from update batches); used only to evaluate the single-step transfer of layers B and C, never for an update; not TEST
batches.same_for: every state of a noise condition (f00 / f60); seeds 1002/1003 use the f60 batches
batches.separate_from: the R30 static calibration FIT batches (labeled loader of the first common GMM split)

reference_state: the common H warmup parent of the same condition and seed (wp_<cond>_s<seed>_H_e5, R30 v1.1 parents/<id>/boundary_state.pt); R29 states (seed 1001) use the s1001 H parent of their condition; peer-averaged eval-path scores

groups.correct_easy: observed pair correct and its true-pair margin > 0 on the reference (true pair above every true negative)
groups.correct_hard: observed pair correct, true-pair margin <= 0 on the reference
groups.mismatch: observed pair is an injected mismatch; split by true_match_available (a true partner is among the candidates) and, per state, selected_competitor_is_true_match

fixed_reference_list: chosen ONCE on the H parent: for every query of the 64 update batches (both directions) its observed positives (observed-ID) and the competitor = highest-scoring observed non-positive under the parent peer-averaged scores; saved with IDs and sha256; evaluated on every measured state (E0 = parent, E10, E40 of R30 units; R29 states auxiliary)

fixed_list_objects.list: K = 128 in-batch candidates, a = uniform over the m observed positives, critic T = (K pi - 1)/(K pi + 1), pi = softmax(s/0.05); oracle S = (K-m)/(K+m); gap = sum (a+q)/2 (T-eta)^2, q = 1/K, eta = (a-q)/(a+q); check S - J = gap
fixed_list_objects.pair: labelled positive (diagonal) vs the fixed competitor, K = 2, m = 1, pi = softmax(((s_pos - s_comp)/0.05, 0)); S = 1/3; same gap check

layers.A: score-space: first-order change under a unit Frobenius step along -dL/dS (joint, both directions) and under each query own-row/column step; update batch only
layers.B: main term only: train mode (dropout seed 20261102 + batch index, shared by all objectives), training grad clip 2.0 on encoder params, ONE AdamW step from the inherited (restored) optimizer moments, lr of the next scheduled co-train epoch, weight decay 1e-4; evaluated on the update and the held-out batch (eval path), then discarded
layers.C: main term + native intra (hinge 0.3, two train-mode passes) + native noisy branch (R27 A1 interface on the state queue/IDs/refiners, the update batch as unlabeled input; NA without a queue), same clip and inherited AdamW step; update and held-out batch
layers.extra_kept_from_v1: X_adam1: fresh-moment AdamW step lr 5e-5 (main term, eval mode); X_gd: normalized GD with the same norm; update batch only

gradient_strength: per query: norm of the score-space gradient of its own loss w.r.t. its row (i2t) / column (t2i); raw = production reduction (coefficient 1); calibrated = x the registered static coefficient (COEFFICIENTS.json of the s1001 H parent of the condition: Ls applied to L, PN, PV, PB); quantiles 0.05/0.25/0.5/0.75/0.95
truth_use: injected-noise map read only by the evaluator (groups, true-pair margin/rank, identity audit); never in losses, gradients, steps, competitor selection of the training objective, or the fixed-list competitor choice
isolation: all layers start from the same restored state: parameters and BN buffers restored after every step, optimizer moments never mutated (update computed out of place), dropout seed fixed per batch; model fingerprint (sha256 of parameters+buffers of both peers) checked equal before/after each state
scope: local one-step behaviour; not a full explanation of training failures
_publication_note: Public excerpt: identity/hash/receipt/host fields and per-problem rows omitted, sample names pseudonymized, numbers unchanged.
